fact: TechCabal refers to mHub as an incubator in Malawi with a former CEO, with no programme or cohort described.
The Secretary for Information and Digitalization says 10 tech hubs under the Digital Malawi Project have trained over 19,000 people in digital skills and given some beneficiaries seed funding.
The ministry said it has supported 10 tech hubs with over $3 million in start-up grants; no programme or cohort described.

The DIGMAP 'Luntha ndi Chuma' initiative, funded by the World Bank, runs through 9 tech hubs, including NXTGen Labs-Mpemba Training Centre in Blantyre, which teaches digital and entrepreneurship courses; no startup incubation cohort is described.
The guide names mHub, the MUBAS Innovation Hub and the Agribiz hub as innovation hubs fostering digital entrepreneurship, with no programme or cohort described.
The Malawi Stock Exchange's Mzinga Incubation Programme, launched 28 July 2023, graduated its first cohort of six companies in Blantyre, with mentorship and training, per the Nation Online report.

UNDP Malawi's Growth Accelerator launched cohorts 9 and 10 in Lilongwe on 1 April 2025 with six-month advisory and up to USD 40,000 co-financing, after eight earlier cohorts since 2018 (UN in Malawi).
Tech Trends Malawi says Malawi has several innovation hubs, some of which run incubation programmes, mHub being an early pioneer, though most depend on donor funding.
